bodies: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)

exams.name: Advanced Long-Term Actuarial Mathematics Exam
exams.blurb: Written-answer paper on contingent payment models, multi-state models and their application to life, annuity and pension products.

exams.name: Advanced Short-Term Actuarial Mathematics Exam
exams.blurb: Written-answer paper on severity and frequency models, coverage modifications, ratemaking and reserving for short-term coverages.

exams.name: Advanced Topics in Predictive Analytics
exams.blurb: E-learning modules and assessment on advanced data science techniques, feature engineering and communicating analytics solutions.

exams.name: Associateship Professionalism Course
exams.blurb: Required seminar on the actuarial code of conduct, standards of practice, qualification standards and professional judgement.

exams.name: Financial Mathematics Exam
exams.blurb: Preliminary paper on interest theory, annuities, loans, bonds, cash flow duration and basic asset liability management.

exams.name: Fundamentals of Actuarial Mathematics Exam
exams.blurb: Intermediate paper combining short-term and long-term actuarial modelling; it replaced the former STAM and LTAM examinations.

exams.name: Fundamentals of Actuarial Practice
exams.blurb: E-learning modules with interim and final assessments applying the actuarial control cycle to product design, pricing and monitoring.

exams.name: Predictive Analytics Exam
exams.blurb: Computer-based project exam requiring candidates to build models in R and communicate findings in a written business report.

exams.name: Probability Exam
exams.blurb: Preliminary paper on probability theory, random variables, distributions and risk management concepts built on calculus.

exams.name: Statistics for Risk Modeling Exam
exams.blurb: Paper on regression, generalised linear models, time series, decision trees and unsupervised learning applied to risk modelling.

exams.name: Validation by Educational Experience Requirements
exams.blurb: Credit in economics, accounting and finance, and mathematical statistics earned through approved coursework or standalone exams.

exams.name: Chartered Enterprise Risk Analyst Credential
exams.blurb: Actuarial enterprise risk credential requiring preliminary exams plus an enterprise risk management module and professionalism course.

exams.name: IICRC Applied Microbial Remediation Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: In-person certification on mould remediation, containment construction, personal protective equipment and category three losses.

exams.name: IICRC Applied Structural Drying Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Hands-on certification on psychrometry, moisture measurement and drying wet structures; requires the water damage certification first.

exams.name: IICRC Carpet Cleaning Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification on fibre identification, cleaning chemistry, soil removal methods and spot treatment for textile floor coverings.

exams.name: IICRC Carpet Repair and Reinstallation Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering carpet repair, patching, seaming, stretching and reinstallation after water or fire damage restoration.

exams.name: IICRC Commercial Drying Specialist
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Advanced certification on drying large commercial buildings, including HVAC use, project documentation and complex loss management.

exams.name: IICRC Contents Processing Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering contents inventory, pack-out procedures, cleaning of personal property and restoration versus replacement calls.

exams.name: IICRC Fire and Smoke Damage Restoration Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering combustion residues, smoke behaviour, cleaning methods and health and safety on fire loss restoration jobs.

exams.name: IICRC Health and Safety Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering OSHA requirements, hazard communication, respiratory protection and jobsite safety for restoration crews.

exams.name: IICRC Odor Control Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification on identifying odour sources and applying source removal, cleaning and deodorisation techniques after a loss.

exams.name: IICRC Trauma and Crime Scene Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering bloodborne pathogen control, biohazard remediation protocols and documentation for trauma scene cleanup.

exams.name: IICRC Water Damage Restoration Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Foundational restoration certification on water categories, drying science, extraction equipment and moisture documentation.

exams.name: CAS Exam 5: Basic Techniques for Ratemaking and Estimating Claim Liabilities
exams.blurb: Property casualty paper covering ratemaking fundamentals, loss reserving techniques and the estimation of unpaid claim liabilities.

exams.name: CAS Exam 6: Regulation and Financial Reporting
exams.blurb: Paper on insurance regulation, statutory accounting, reinsurance accounting and financial reporting, offered in US and Canada versions.

exams.name: CAS Exam 7: Estimation of Policy Liabilities, Insurance Company Valuation and Enterprise Risk Management
exams.blurb: Fellowship paper covering advanced reserving methods, insurance company valuation and enterprise risk management frameworks.

exams.name: CAS Exam 8: Advanced Ratemaking
exams.blurb: Fellowship paper covering classification ratemaking, excess and deductible pricing, increased limits factors and individual risk rating.

exams.name: CAS Exam 9: Financial Risk and Rate of Return
exams.blurb: Fellowship paper covering portfolio theory, capital allocation, cost of capital and rate of return considerations in insurance pricing.

exams.name: CAS Modern Actuarial Statistics I
exams.blurb: Paper covering probability models, stochastic processes, statistics and generalised linear models for casualty actuarial work.

exams.name: CAS Modern Actuarial Statistics II
exams.blurb: Paper covering credibility, linear mixed models, Bayesian analysis and statistical learning methods applied to insurance data.

exams.name: CAS Property and Casualty Predictive Analytics
exams.blurb: Project-based assessment requiring candidates to build, validate and report on a predictive model using insurance data in R.

exams.name: Associate, Annuity Products and Administration
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering annuity product design, suitability, contract administration and distribution for operations staff.

exams.name: Associate, Customer Service
exams.blurb: Designation programme for insurance service staff covering service quality, communication skills and policy servicing transactions.

exams.name: Associate, Insurance Regulatory Compliance
exams.blurb: Designation programme covering insurance regulation, market conduct, privacy, advertising rules and compliance programme governance.

exams.name: Associate, Life Management Institute
exams.blurb: Five-course milestone within the FLMI programme covering insurance principles, company operations, administration and marketing.

exams.name: Fellow, Financial Services Institute
exams.blurb: Designation programme of seven courses plus professional achievement credits aimed at broader financial services operations staff.

exams.name: Fellow, Life Management Institute
exams.blurb: Ten-course designation programme covering life insurance principles, operations, law, accounting, investing and product development.

exams.name: Fellow, Secure Retirement Institute
exams.blurb: Designation programme of seven courses on retirement products, plan distribution, decumulation and retirement industry operations.
